microphone.text: Once upon a time in a quiet village, a curious fox named Finn discovered a glowing lantern hidden in the woods. Every night it whispered secrets of faraway lands. Finn followed its light through twisting paths until he reached a sparkling river. There, the lantern revealed a bridge made of stars. Crossing it, he found a hidden meadow where animals danced under moonlight. But dawn approached and the lantern dimmed. Finn hurried back carrying its fading glow in his heart. From then on, he shared tales of the star bridge with his village friends, inspiring them to dream beyond the trees. And though the lantern vanished, its magic lived on in every storyteller's voice.
